He was not sure which club to join, if one at all; but under some pressure from Tommy Scrimshaw and Ernie Duffett he decided on Belgrave, "mainly because I liked their vest".

1927 was a bumper year indeed with TOMMY SCRIMSHAW (three times an International at 880 yards before he was 21), JOE COLEMAN, ERNIE DUFFETT, who guided the destinies of our runners for 25 years, and Olympic champion TOMMY GREEN all signing Belgrave forms.
An outstanding run on that evening was by a junior, TOMMY SCRIMSHAW from South Kensington,who was to be a treble-International at 880 yards, before his 21st birthday.

Our first Southern Cross-country Championship was won during his term of office; followed later by our first E.C.C.U. triumph; our first London-Brighton Road Relay win was achieved; and on the track,athletes such as TOMMY SCRIMSHAW, JIM TOSH and JOHN CLEMENS were carrying our colours with distinction.
Congratulations also to Jim Tosh and Tom Scrimshaw upon finishing first and second, with inches between them, in the Inter-Counties 880 yards.'

We missed Tommy Scrimshaw from our opening road races - he invariably comes along to these and to have a chat with old friends. He has been on holiday in Australia and went to Brisbane to see the "mock-up" for the forthcoming Commonwealth Games.
High on the International Honours Board at Belgrave Hall is the name of Tommy Scrimshaw. We are sorry to learn that he died in March at the age of 73.
